needs.proposedSignature: AltCost.id gains 'madness' ({ id: 'madness', label: 'madness', cost, from: 'exile' }) plus a discard replacement static { kind: 'discard-replacement', instead: 'exile-then-may-cast' } that exiles the discarded card and creates a reflexive trigger to cast it for its madness cost.
needs.semantics: If a player would discard this card, they discard it into exile instead. When they do, they may cast it for its madness cost; if they don't, it goes to the graveyard.
